data_deps.name: dbim_data
data_deps.description: Datasets (e2h, DIODE, ImageNet), checkpoints, FID stats, and inception model for DBIM tasks.

install_cmds: apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y wget curl unzip && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
pip install blobfile piq matplotlib opencv-python joblib lmdb scipy clean-fid easydict torchmetrics rich ipdb wandb gdown
mkdir -p /data/torch_cache && TORCH_HOME=/data/torch_cache python -c "import torchvision; torchvision.models.resnet50(weights='IMAGENET1K_V1'); print('ResNet50 cached')"

TORCH_HOME=/data/torch_cache python -c "from torchmetrics.image.lpip import LearnedPerceptualImagePatchSimilarity; m = LearnedPerceptualImagePatchSimilarity(net_type='vgg'); print('VGG for LPIPS cached')"
